title: Booking page
description: Your public page where customers book. Publish it, share it everywhere, and make it look like you.

publish.draft: Your booking page is a draft
publish.noSubscription: Bookings are currently switched off because there’s no active subscription.
publish.verifyEmail: Confirm your email address first. Check your inbox for the link.
publish.needsService: Add at least one active service with a team member assigned, then publish.

pause.messageHint: Shown on your booking page while paused.
pause.messagePlaceholder: We’re on holiday until 3 September. See you soon!

celebrate.title: Your booking page is live.
celebrate.body: Share the link on Instagram, Google Business Profile or WhatsApp, or print the QR code for your counter.

share.title: Share
share.description: Put your link wherever customers find you.
share.qrDescription: For your counter, flyers or business cards. Bookings from it are tracked as “QR code”.
share.campaigns: Campaign links (track where bookings come from)
share.campaignsBody: Add UTM parameters and bookings will show the campaign in Analytics:

embed.title: Add booking to your website
embed.description: Paste one line into your site. The booking flow opens in a secure, self-contained window, so it won’t clash with your site’s design.
embed.buttonDescription: A button that opens booking in a popup.
embed.inlineDescription: The full booking flow embedded where you place the code.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Your logo, cover and colour. The preview updates as you edit.
branding.policyHint: Shown on your page and in confirmation emails, e.g. late arrivals, deposits, cancellations.
branding.showStaff: Show team members on your page
branding.showStaffHint: Let customers choose who they’d like to see.

upload.tooLarge: That file is larger than 5 MB.
upload.formats: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB.

seo.title: Search & social previews
seo.description: How your page appears on Google and when shared.
seo.indexing: Allow search engines to list this page
seo.indexingHint: Turn off if you only share the link privately.

link.title: Booking link
link.description: Changing it breaks links you’ve already shared (including printed QR codes).

qrPrint.scan: Scan to book your next appointment

errors.slugTaken: That booking link is already taken.
